notes.title: New Minigame, Customizable Controls & More!
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a while!

I wanted this update to be worth it so I've made sure to listen to everyone that has had something to say and I want to thank everyone for their suggestions!

A big one is customizable controls, being able to rebind the controls is something that many people requested and I can finally say I have managed to finally figure it out. It wasn't easy! To anyone that wants to use this feature it is located in the menu after all the minigames.

On top of that, we have a new minigame to play! This minigame is a fighting game with ninjas and martial arts. There is still room for improvement but I have had a lot of positive reports so far! Let me know what you think!

Lastly, some smaller changes here and there such as being able to select ingredients faster in 'Not Enough Chefs', some tweaks to how the menus are arranged, and some bits and bobs here and there.

I have also published a guide on how to change the voice-over narrator because I know some players aren't keen with the one they're dealt. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2800988962]Check it out here![/url]

If you have any issues, find any bugs, or want to share your suggestions, leave a response or a review, I'm always about!

Enjoy!

notes.title: More Leaderboards & Increasing Difficulty! - v0.3.10
notes.content:
So now all minigames should have working leaderboards! Woohoo!

On top of that, the zombies will get faster over time as to not get too boring.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Zombie Survival Leaderboards! - v0.3.9
notes.content:
So the last update didn't wok quite how I thought it would, but now Zombie Survival should have working leaderboards!

If you come across any issues, don't hesitate to open a discussion!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Testing Leaderboards! - v0.3.8
notes.content: Just testing some leaderboards, expect a few bugs!

notes.title: Helicopter! - v0.3.7
notes.content:
Just a small update, changed the volume for a few sounds as to not overwhelm others and also added a helicopter that will fly over head in the Zombie Survival minigame!

I've also published a guide in the Community Hub on how to change the voice-over narrator.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to Gabriel's Auditory Playground! The game that does not rely on sight [i]at all[/i].

With the initial release there are two minigames to choose from, shoot some zombies or cook some burgers. As you know, I plan on coming in with a good few more options in the near future or expanding on the few I know work best.

I hope you enjoy the game but if you have any feedback at all, good or bad, please make sure to fill out this [url=https://forms.gle/LEGq8kRWPyzPBwcX8]survey![/url]

Enjoy!
